messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I will never know the real truth or context behind this story, only what I observed.

output.original_text: I will never know the real truth or context behind this story, only what I observed.
output.joy: I might not know the full truth or context behind this story, but what I observed brings me joy!
output.sadness: I will sadly never know the real truth or the full context behind this story, just the fragments of what I observed.
output.fear: I will never uncover the real truth or context behind this story, and that uncertainty fills me with fear.
output.anger: I'll never know the real truth or context behind this story, and that really frustrates me!
output.surprise: I will never know the real truth or context behind this story—what a surprising twist it has!
output.disgust: I will never know the real truth or context behind this story, only the unpleasant reality of what I observed.
